decisionMemo.businessProblem: Churn jumped and the owner wants to rebuild loyalty, but customers are leaving for a reason loyalty programs won't fix.

rootCauseDiagnosis.description: Pricing power failure from under-pricing, discount leakage, or price realization gap
rootCauseDiagnosis.mechanismDescription: Realized price sits below comparable competitors or below list through uncontrolled discounting; the gap is price realization, not cost.
alternativeExplanations: Mix shift rather than a price-realization gap
missingEvidenceFor: Discount-approval governance and leakage by rep

criticalConstraints.description: No customer relationship management system or loyalty program infrastructure

intervention.title: Run a price-realization and discount-leakage analysis and a win/loss price-sensitivity review
intervention.objective: Quantify the price-realization gap and discount leakage before any price change
intervention.rationale: A price-realization and discount-leakage analysis is analysis-only and reversible; it avoids an across-the-board price increase without elasticity data.
intervention.whyThisNow: The gap is price realization, not cost; the leakage must be measured before any pricing move

steps.title: Analyze price realization and discount leakage
steps.description: Measure realized vs list price and discount leakage by deal/rep against comparable competitors.
steps.successCriteria: Price-realization gap and discount leakage quantified by segment

steps.title: Run a win/loss price-sensitivity review
steps.description: Review win/loss and willingness-to-pay to size reversible price/governance levers — no blanket hike.
steps.successCriteria: Reversible pricing-governance levers shortlisted with elasticity evidence

failureRisks: Elasticity data may be thin in some segments
intervention.fallbackPlan: Pilot a governed discount-approval policy before any list-price change
